continuation.summary: The three existing ATS triage tests pass, but the mandatory regression test file is missing. Source inspection identifies a safety gap: exact contact-field labels can become verified_candidate even when their control types are hidden, submit, button, or otherwise unsupported. The repair must restrict verified candidates to explicitly supported text-entry controls. The execution contract permits modifying tools/ats_question_triage.py and creating tests/test_ats_question_triage_regression.py, but prohibits editing the existing triage tests.: Use pinned HEAD 71fcf63791385799972638aa10b66cdea049134e. Modify only tools/ats_question_triage.py and tests/test_ats_question_triage_regression.py. Keep tests/test_ats_question_triage.py unchanged. Unsupported, unknown, hidden, and action controls must always require human review, even with verified contact labels. Supported text, email, tel, and url controls must preserve exact verified-contact matching. The isolated worker must independently run all four mandatory test cases, verify successful results, and record commit and execution evidence. No private data, network access, applications, deployment, or automatic merge.
